purpose: Linked discovery index for positive, useful Odisha tourism storytelling.
scope: Seed collection, not a statewide census, ranking or booking directory.

relationship_rules.place_association: Source supports the food/place association; no live purchase route.
relationship_rules.regional_pairing: Editorial area grouping; no measured proximity.
relationship_rules.onsite: Source connects an amenity to a heritage site or its visitor precinct.
relationship_rules.area_membership: Destination grouping; no implied walking distance, quality endorsement or availability.

areas.name: Puri and the craft corridor
areas.scope: Puri is the base; Raghurajpur, Pipili and Nimapada are separately identified regional stops. This grouping is editorial, not a measured nearby radius.

food_links.note: Puri temple-food tradition; purchase and visitor access require checking.
Associated with Nimapada; proposed regional extension, not a claim of walking proximity to Puri.

areas.editorial_hook: Heritage, food and craft can each give a visitor a different reason to spend more time here.
areas.research_priority: Temple visitor rules; named food providers; willing craft hosts; point-to-point travel; facilities at each craft stop.

areas.name: Konark
areas.scope: Konark town and Sun Temple visitor area.
areas.editorial_hook: Let architectural detail lead the story, then make planning the visit straightforward.
areas.research_priority: Current ticketing and hours; operating status of the interpretation centre and amenities; local food vendors; last-mile transport.

areas.name: Bhubaneswar
areas.scope: City-wide collection; museum locations and Old Town are different stops.

food_links.note: Old Town / Lingaraj temple area; no claim that either museum serves it.

areas.editorial_hook: Introduce a city through what its people make, preserve and eat.
areas.research_priority: Expand ancient heritage coverage; map museum and Old Town routes; named food makers; current programmes; accessibility details.

areas.name: Cuttack
areas.scope: City-wide collection; Jobra museum and food traditions are separate parts of the proposed story.

food_links.note: A 2020 contributor account supports the Cuttack association; current vendors remain unverified.

areas.editorial_hook: A maritime chapter and a food chapter can invite visitors to explore the city more deeply.
areas.research_priority: Current food vendors; museum visitor services; silver filigree makers; safe and realistic routes.

areas.name: Buddhist circuit
areas.scope: Ratnagiri and Udayagiri in Jajpur, with Lalitgiri in Cuttack district. Multiple sites, not one walkable precinct.
areas.editorial_hook: Give each archaeological site its own identity, interpretation and reason to pause.
areas.research_priority: Current site and museum access; local food providers; lodging bases; transport; toilets, water, shade and accessibility at every site.
